title: Answer every lead in minutes without adding staff.

blocks.text: Answer every lead in minutes without adding staff.

Real estate teams lose deals to slow replies and lose evenings to paperwork. These workflows handle the first response, the document chase and the status updates, and the agent handles the relationship and the negotiation.
Leads go cold while the agent is at a viewing
Portal and website inquiries wait until someone is at a desk. The first agent to reply often gets the conversation.
Listings take an evening each
Photos, floor plans and notes become descriptions, portal entries and social posts, each typed separately.
Transactions stall on missing documents
IDs, proof of funds, surveys and certificates are chased by email. Nobody has a single view of what is still missing on each deal.
Past clients and old leads are never called
The database holds years of contacts, but follow-up depends on an agent remembering.

What we have shipped that looks like this
These are results from work that uses the same pattern. Most clients are described rather than named.
Lexi (notary platform)

We built one platform with a view per role for admins, notaries and clients. Meetings are recorded and turned into text, documents are read and filed without re-typing, and each client update reaches the right notary as it happens. Notary and transaction work has a similar document shape to a property deal.

One workflow, one owner, a person checking the important decisions. We expand only after the first workflow has a track record.

What should stay human
Property is a trust business with legal formalities. These stay with people.
Pricing and valuation advice
The system quotes listed prices from your data. Valuation, offers and negotiation stay with the agent.
Legal and contract terms
We track documents and deadlines. A lawyer or notary judges what a clause or certificate means.
Statements about a property
Anything said about condition, size or legal status comes from verified intake data and is reviewed before it reaches the public.
Fair housing and discrimination rules
Qualification questions and routing rules are reviewed by a person against the rules that apply in your market. We do not use protected characteristics in scoring.
